subject: general
question: Sulphur-cleaning device in coal plants not necessary. What is the main purpose of Flu Gas Desulphurisation (FGD) units?

options.text: To remove fly ash from flue gases
To remove sulphur dioxide (SO₂) from flue gases
To increase the efficiency of coal combustion

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**To remove sulphur dioxide (SO₂) from flue gases**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Sulphur-cleaning device in coal plants not necessary: Central scientific committee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A **high-powered committee** has recommended scrapping the **mandate** for Flu Gas Desulphurisation (**FGD**) units in all coal-fired **thermal power plants (TPP)**.

 
 
• 
 
Current **SO₂ levels** in ambient air are about **10-20 micrograms/m³**, well below India's **air quality norm** of 80.

 
 
• 
 
**Stack heights** and **climatic conditions** in India help disperse SO₂, reducing local air pollution risks.

 
 
• 
 
**Indian coal** has **low sulphur content**, and SO₂ levels near plants with and without FGD units show no significant difference.

 
 
• 
 
**FGD technology** removes sulphur dioxide (SO₂) from flue gases of **coal-based thermal power plants**.

 
 
• 
 
FGD units were mandated by the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** in 2015, with deadlines extended up to **2027-2029** based on location and capacity.

 
 
• 
 
Flue gases pass through a **limestone slurry (CaCO₃)** scrubber, converting SO₂ to **calcium sulphite**, then to **gypsum** (calcium sulphate dihydrate).

 
 
• 
 
Before FGD, **Electrostatic Precipitators (ESPs)** and **Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR)** units remove **fly ash** and **NOx** respectively.

 
 
• 
 
FGD installation involves **high capital costs** and is **water intensive**.
